bullets.text: Avoid MTD Misunderstandings - Misconceptions about **Making Tax Digital** can lead to non-compliance and penalties for sole traders and landlords.
Interactive MTD Checklist - A click-to-tick checklist simplifies **MTD for Income Tax** requirements, ensuring compliance by April 2026.
Understanding Digital Links - Complying with **MTD** requires proper digital links to avoid penalties when transferring accounting data.
